settings.heading: THE LIVING plus THE STOP.
settings.copy: THE LIVING means life, movement, vibrancy, and community. THE STOP is the red circle: a hard stop on harmful systems. Together, they mean choosing kindness, quality, and conscious living.

settings.copy: Once you choose this way of living, you need nothing else. Premium streetwear first. A serious ethical mission built into the DNA.
